purpose: Quantify whether the same 2025 fields are repeatedly geometry-stable across 2015-2024 and whether field-specific history can inform the 2026 unchanged/split/merge prior.

latest_year_pseudo_backtest.interpretation: Descriptive calibration using 2025-reference identity history; not an out-of-time causal validation.

independence_benchmark.note: Uses the observed year-specific strict-same marginal rates for 2015-2024. This avoids assuming a common annual probability when comparing the observed per-field stability-count distribution with an independent-years benchmark.
